name: Robertsport
subtitle: Robertsport is a fishing town in Grand Cape Mount on the Liberian coast near the Sierra Leone border, beside Lake Piso, a Ramsar-listed coastal lagoon.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: A fishing village on the border of Sierra Leone

facts.label: Surfing arrives
facts.value: Surfing was first introduced in 2003 by a group of American tourists, according to local surfer Philip Banini

facts.label: First Liberian surfer
facts.value: Alfred Lomax, taught by the visitors, shared the sport with locals

facts.label: Size of community
facts.value: About 4,000 people, including over 60 local surfers (2022)

facts.label: National standing
facts.value: One of Liberia's three main surfing destinations, with Monrovia and Harper

facts.label: Lake Piso
facts.value: Ramsar site designated 2 July 2003; 76,091 ha; Singe, Robertsport, Grand Cape Mount

facts.label: Lagoon
facts.value: An open coastal lagoon near Robertsport, the largest such inlet on the Liberian coast

facts.label: People depending on the lake
facts.value: About 38 communities, around 7,000 people, rely on it for transport and fishing

parts.text: Robertsport is a fishing town in Grand Cape Mount on the Liberian coast near the Sierra Leone border, beside Lake Piso, a Ramsar-listed coastal lagoon. After 2003, American visitors introduced surfing, and it is now a small local surf community.
